uxFeatures.benchCharts: Project charts on the bench (statuses & activity)

list_projects.description: Returns a list of all DIY projects: title, status, budget, number of tasks. Use it to select a project before detailed operations.

get_project_details.description: Returns detailed information about a project: tasks, linked components (reservations) and orders. Use it when the projectId is known.

get_task_details.description: Returns details of a project task: description, priority, status, linked components and orders.

get_shopping_list.description: Returns the project's shopping list — components still to buy (needed minus reserved minus free stock), with a last-paid cost estimate and total.

create_project.description: Creates a new DIY project with a title and status. Optionally sets start/due dates.

params.title: Project title
params.status: Status: IDEA, PLANNING, IN_PROGRESS, TESTING, COMPLETED
params.groupId: Identifier or reference of the group to file the project in; omit for the default group

update_project.description: Updates project fields: title, description, status, start/due dates, planned budget. Pass only the fields you want to change.

add_task.description: Adds a new task to a project.

toggle_task.description: Marks a task as completed or not completed.

update_task.description: Updates a task's fields: title, description, priority (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), due date. Use toggle_task to change completion. Pass taskId and only the fields you want to change.

params.taskId: Identifier of the task being updated
params.title: New title. Optional.
params.priority: New priority: LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH. Optional.

link_component_to_project.description: Links a warehouse component to a project with the required quantity specified.

delete_project.description: Deletes the entire project. WARNING: destructive action — the project tasks, reservations and links will be deleted.

params.projectId: Identifier of the project to delete

delete_task.description: Deletes a project task. WARNING: destructive action.

params.taskId: Identifier of the task to delete

unlink_component_from_project.description: Unlinks a component from a project and releases its reservation. WARNING: destructive action.

list_project_files.description: Lists the files stored in a project: name, type, size and a reference for each. Use it to find a file to read with read_attachment, or to tell the user what the project holds.

params.projectId: Project reference ("mk://projects/project/<id>") or its raw id.

list_project_groups.description: Returns the tree of project groups — the folders projects are filed in.

create_project_group.description: Creates a project group. Give parentId to nest it inside another group.

params.name: Name of the new group
params.parentId: Identifier or reference of the parent group; omit for a top-level group

move_project_to_group.description: Moves a project into another group.

params.projectId: Identifier or reference of the project to move
params.groupId: Identifier or reference of the destination group

delete_project_group.description: Deletes a project group. WARNING: destructive action — the group disappears; its projects and subgroups move to the parent group.

params.groupId: Identifier or reference of the group to delete

errors.groupNameTaken: A group with this name already exists here.
errors.groupCycle: A group cannot be moved into itself or into one of its own subgroups.
errors.groupDefaultUndeletable: The default group cannot be deleted.
